AutoDNA — Project API Reference¶

API documentation for AutoDNA: the desktop application (app/ — drive loading, GPS/DEM turn and hill detection, segment fuel records, the Ridge fuel-consumption model, and the PyQt6 UI), the IMU signal-processing and feature code (ai/), the STM32 binary parser (stm32/), and the test suite (tests/).

Contents

  • App Modules
    • Core
    • UI
    • Legacy / unused in the live app
  • AI / Signal Processing (ai/)
    • Signal preprocessing & features
    • Dataset & demo pipeline
    • BiLSTM experiments
    • GRU experiment
    • Window-based CNN / XGBoost
  • STM32 Data Logger (stm32/)
    • Binary parser
    • Serial service & live stream
  • Test Suite (tests/)
    • test_stm32.py — binary parser
    • test_ai.py — preprocessing, features, labels
    • test_gps.py — the live GPS pipeline
    • test_integration.py — real committed data (optional)
